description: This file defines the SwipeRefreshListFragment class, a subclass of ListFragment that adds swipe-to-refresh functionality using a customized SwipeRefreshLayout. It manages layout wrapping, refresh state, and color schemes for the refresh control.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that provides swipe-to-refresh support by encapsulating its content view within a custom SwipeRefreshLayout.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragment.ListFragmentSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: An internal subclass of SwipeRefreshLayout that overrides canChildScrollUp() to correctly signal when the inner ListView can be scrolled up, facilitating swipe-to-refresh gesture detection.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides the fragment's onCreateView to wrap the default list view in a SwipeRefreshLayout and return it as the fragment's content view.

methods.name: setOnRefreshListener
methods.description: Sets an OnRefreshListener on the SwipeRefreshLayout to handle swipe-to-refresh events.

methods.name: isRefreshing
methods.description: Returns whether the SwipeRefreshLayout is currently in the refreshing state.

methods.name: setRefreshing
methods.description: Sets the refreshing state of the SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: setColorScheme
methods.description: Configures the color scheme of the refresh indicator in the SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: getSwipeRefreshLayout
methods.description: Provides access to the internal SwipeRefreshLayout instance.
